title: 第7章 争论过后第8章 剑法是寒师兄教的
content_zh:
;;
此时苏白尘已经被带到了另一处偏殿，好几个大佬在那吵得不可开交。
“这娃儿明明是天生该练剑的，你们这些炼气的和我们练剑的争什么？”
两个背负长剑的道人气场全开，在那不断喷口水。
但是他们面前一个身穿玄色道袍气度雍容的中年道人，他毫无波澜地说：“此子只是聆听我徒枫林的诵经就能有所触动，他分明只是缺一个引导之法而已。”
“若是陈师弟的炼气课上在剑术课之前，他同样可以轻松炼气入道……这哪里是什么剑道天才，分明就是个炼气天才。”
苏白尘已经听了一会儿了，知道这个道人就是枫林子的师父玄阴真人。
另一边，身穿明黄道袍的开阳真人赞同道：“玄阴师弟说的在理，此子禀赋非凡，的确不能仓促下定论。”
“这样，我们不如问问他自己的想法如何？”
宫主发话了，大家当然只能赞同。开阳真人还是长春宫的宫主，涉及到自家道统内优秀弟子的去向，这对他来说也是一件很重要的事情。
“苏白尘，你若愿入剑宗，可拜入剑宗宗主无锋剑老座下，他想必会对你倾囊而授。”
“若你要进入阴宗，自然有玄阴真人收你为徒。”
“当然你也可以拜我为师，我亦是阳宗宗主，一样倾囊相授……”
玄阴真人等阴宗众人以及无锋剑老等剑宗众人看着开阳真人都是双眼要喷火……好家伙，原以为只是他们两家在争弟子，没想到这开阳真人还要横插一刀！
但是大家拿这不要脸的宫主没办法，只能都将目光投向了苏白尘，这一下则是将压力给到了他身上……
苏白尘心里头则是不断分析着当前的情况。
他要何去何从？
他对剑宗也没什么好感，因为那青锋寒教导他们的时候根本不用心。
他倒是比较偏向玄阴真人，因为他很喜欢枫林子师兄。
至于开阳真人？

如果他是个功利心重想着要不断往上爬的人，那么长春宫主开阳真人就是最佳选择。
可现在他只想说：我们不熟。
苏白尘沉吟了一下，在众人期待注视中以有些惶恐腼腆的神态道：“弟子以为至少还有三个月才到想这些的时候，现在弟子真的不知该如何决断啊。”
众人一听，原本已经是剑拔弩张的气氛立刻松弛了下来。
因为苏白尘说的可太对了，外门弟子的三月之期可不只是对弟子的考验，也是弟子们系统地学习修行知识，然后对自己未来做出初步规划的阶段。
开阳宫主赞许地颔首道：“那就三月之后再说吧，正好你也可以趁这段时间多看看各宗长处。”
这事就这么定了下来。
“枫林子，你送这孩子回去吧。”
玄阴真人很自然地开口，随后看着枫林子眨了眨眼。
枫林子会意，随后笑着说：“师弟，我们走吧。”
苏白尘立刻跟了上去。
而殿中大佬们都是看着玄阴真人一阵磨牙，他们知道这家伙已经抢占先机。
但无锋剑老并不准备放弃，他看向青锋寒：“别再让我看到你小子在教外门的时候偷懒了！给我好好教听到没有？尤其对那些有天赋的人，绝不能错过任何人才！”
他也要下注了。
青锋寒苦着脸点头，他知道自己舒坦的日子就这么过去了……
……
返回的路上，枫林子很沉默，气氛有些尴尬。
苏白尘率先破冰：“师兄，那个陈长老是哪个宗的？”

At this time, Su Baichen had been taken to another side hall, where several big shots were arguing.
"This kid was obviously born to practice swordsmanship. Why are you Qi practitioners arguing with us sword practitioners?"
The auras of the two Taoists with long swords on their backs were fully activated, and they were constantly spitting.
But in front of them was a graceful middle-aged Taoist wearing a black Taoist robe. He said without any hesitation: "This boy can be touched just by listening to my disciple Fenglin's chanting. He clearly just lacks a way to guide him."
"If Junior Brother Chen takes Qi refining class before the swordsmanship class, he can also easily refine Qi and enter the Tao... This is not a swordsman genius, he is clearly a Qi refining genius."
Su Baichen had been listening for a while and knew that this Taoist was Feng Linzi's master Xuanyin Zhenren.
On the other side, Master Kaiyang, who was wearing a bright yellow Taoist robe, agreed: "Junior Brother Xuanyin is right. This boy has extraordinary talent. We really cannot make hasty conclusions."
"In this case, how about we ask him what he thinks?"
The Palace Master has spoken, and of course everyone can only agree. Kaiyang Zhenren is also the palace master of Changchun Palace, and it involves the whereabouts of outstanding disciples in his family's Taoism. This is also a very important matter for him.
"Su Baichen, if you want to join the Sword Sect, you can worship under the master of the Sword Sect, Wu Fengjian, and he will definitely give you the gift."
"If you want to enter the Yin Sect, Master Xuanyin will naturally accept you as a disciple."
"Of course you can also worship me as your teacher. I am also the head of the Yang Sect, and I will teach you the same way..."
Master Xuanyin and other members of the Yin Sect, as well as Master Wufeng Jianlao and other members of the Sword Sect, looked at Master Kaiyang with their eyes spitting fire... Good guy, I thought it was just the two families competing for disciples, but I didn't expect that Master Kaiyang would stab him in the side!
But everyone had nothing to do with this shameless palace master. They could only turn their attention to Su Baichen, and this time they put pressure on him...
Su Baichen was constantly analyzing the current situation in his mind.
Where does he want to go from here?
He didn't have a good impression of Jian Zong either, because Qing Fenghan didn't care at all when he taught them.
He prefers Master Xuanyin because he likes senior brother Feng Linzi very much.
As for the real person Kaiyang?
If he is a utilitarian person who wants to keep climbing up, then the master of Changchun Palace, Kaiyang Zhenren, is the best choice.
But now he just wants to say: We are not familiar with each other.
Su Baichen pondered for a moment, and said with a somewhat fearful and shy expression as everyone watched expectantly: "I thought it would be at least three months before I would think about this. Now I really don't know how to make a decision."
When everyone heard this, the already tense atmosphere immediately relaxed.
Because what Su Baichen said is so right, the three-month period for outer disciples is not only a test for the disciples, but also a stage for the disciples to systematically learn cultivation knowledge and then make preliminary plans for their future.
Palace Master Kaiyang nodded approvingly and said, "Let's talk about it after three months. You can also take advantage of this period to see more of the strengths of each sect."
The matter was settled like that.
"Feng Linzi, please send this child back."
Master Xuanyin spoke naturally, then looked at Feng Linzi and blinked.
Feng Linzi understood, and then said with a smile: "Junior brother, let's go."
Su Baichen followed immediately.
The big guys in the palace all looked at Master Xuanyin and gritted their teeth. They knew that this guy had already seized the opportunity.
But Wufeng Jianlao was not ready to give up. He looked at Qing Fenghan and said, "Don't let me see you kid being lazy when teaching the outer sect again! Give me a good education, okay? Especially for those who are talented, we must not miss any talent!"
He's going to place a bet too.
Qing Fenghan nodded with a grimace, knowing that his comfortable days were over...
…
On the way back, Feng Linzi was silent and the atmosphere was a bit awkward.
Su Baichen took the lead to break the ice: "Brother, where is that Elder Chen?"A sect? "
